messages:
maria.s: Security advisory: we found plaintext SMTP credentials for the marketing mailhook in a public analytics repo. Impact: prod + staging. We're enforcing a Conditional Access policy on the service principal and rotating secrets now. Please follow steps below.

tuan.p: Acknowledged. I'll rotate smtp user/password in staging and run smoke tests.

maria.s: Rotation checklist (short): 1) create new secret in secrets manager (short TTL) 2) update k8s secret via reference to secret id, not literal 3) restart deployment or wait for secret controller 4) validate delivery metrics for 30m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/security/rotations/mailhook-1755009876

jen.w: CI updated to pull new secret id from terraform var. Will open prod PR after staging is green.

ops-bot: deploy lock applied to svc=mailhook (reason=secret-rotation).

tuan.p: Staging rotated and verified :white_check_mark:. No errors. Kicking prod rotation now.

maria.s: Security will audit service principals tonight and force-rotate any long-lived client secrets older than 90 days. If you need an exception, DM me with justification. Avoid committing creds to repos; prefer federated identities.

jen.w: Prod rotated, rollout healthy. Monitoring alert created for mail deliveries. Thanks team.

maria.s: Closing advisory: file an incident ticket if you see elevated error rates. Thanks for quick response. :pray:
